name: web-page
description: External web-page CONSUMER: one-call JS-aware page read (playwright-core chromium render, main-content to compact markdown, URL+content-hash cache, char cap with spill) exposed as the tools 'page read' and 'page map'

cacheDir.description: where the page cache and the spill files live (default: <tmp>/workbench-web-page)

cacheTtlSeconds.description: how long a cache entry counts as fresh

maxChars.description: default cap of a returned body

hardMaxChars.description: cap a caller can never exceed

spillDir.description: where the full text of a capped page is written (default: <cacheDir>/spill)

actionTimeoutMs.description: bounded secondary wait budget (network idle, first paint)

retries.description: extra navigation attempts after a transport failure

executablePath.description: chromium binary; absent: playwright resolves it (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH)

blockResourceTypes.description: resource types never downloaded (default image, media, font)

proxy.description: per-request proxy; 'credential' is a credential NAME, never a value

credential.description: credential NAME resolved through ctx.credentials at launch time

mapMaxChars.description: default cap of the page map outline
